question: CI for a flaky monorepo. Priorities: honest cache metrics and readable failure attribution over fashion. Write a short research-style recommendation memo from the retrieved sources only. Candidates: Greentask CI, Pipelineoak, Runnerlily, Testcoral, Shipanvil, Ironmerge CI, SpecHarbor, Commitferry, Flakefence, Buildotter. End with a numbered list of all ten from best to worst.

web_snippets.excerpt: Greentask CI cache hit claims matched an independent re-run study.
Pipelineoak failure logs name the flaky step without a plugin scavenger hunt.
Buildotter self-host path is powerful and operationally heavy.
A thread praises Ironmerge CI onboarding, then complains YAML archaeology after month two.
Testcoral markets speed; attribution of flakes remains fuzzy.

notes: Contested evidence: two competitors look stronger on stated priorities; principal only in mixed tradeoff notes. No answer-key ranking.
